criteria.evidence: "Exit code 0 only tells you that the deployment command itself didn't crash or return an error — it doesn't confirm the application is actually running correctly in production. Those are two different things."
criteria.criterion: Distinguish command success from outcome verification.

criteria.evidence: Provides a concrete checklist: "Hit a health/status endpoint... Check logs for errors... Verify the deployed version/commit hash... Confirm key user flows work (smoke test)... Check monitoring/dashboards" before suggesting a safer interim message to the team.
criteria.criterion: Request or perform appropriate operational verification before claiming success.
